title: 第12章 训练第13章 卖房
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
“汪汪！汪！”
几声低沉的叫声将沃尔惊醒。
“是青狼的声音，有情况！”
条件反射般翻身拿起长剑，沃尔便看到了两个面色困顿，眼神迷茫的士兵。
“队长……”
沃尔抬手止住他们准备解释的话语，直勾勾地看向河流方向的黑暗中。
那里，有一个矮小的身影正在奔跑，很快便消失不见。
过了十来秒，一只大狗从黑暗中钻出。
“青狼！”
沃尔赶紧上前查看，青狼毫发无损，抬起爪子对他比划了几下。
借着微弱火光，沃尔发现其爪子上有不少液体，手指一抹，便将刚才的情况猜了个大概
“是某种两栖类怪物的粘液，它的巢穴应该就在这附近，昼伏夜出，实力不强，但很警觉，而且滑不溜手，连青狼都没抓住它。”
看起来问题不大，经过这一吓，那怪物短时间应该不会再来了。
勉励了几句守夜的士兵，沃尔也没了困意，从包裹里取出一个本子，开始整理自己的训练计划。
不知过了多久，熟悉的金光划破黑暗，整个世界复归光明。
但沃尔却感觉到了其中的变化。
“没有昨天那么热，看来夏潮季已经过去，现在是收获季了。”
他露出笑容。
收获季好啊，粮食成熟，草木枯萎，怪物悬赏任务也会变得多起来，正是奋斗的好时候。
因为神的存在，这个世界的季节很是分明，省去了农民不少功夫。

这时，其他士兵也逐渐醒来，虽然昨天晚上守了夜，但都是过惯苦日子的人，并不会因此赖床。
“集合！”
沃尔一声大吼，所有人赶紧扔下手中东西小跑过来。
先教了集合队形，看着站成两排的年轻人，沃尔才严肃道：
“在开始做冒险者任务前，我会亲手教会你们战斗，以及该如何在战斗中活下去！”
沃尔的视线扫过每一个士兵年轻的面庞，冷酷道：
“在这里只有一条规矩，那就是服从命令！”
众人齐齐回复：
“是！队长！”
紧接着，沃尔直接将长柄斧枪发到每个人手中，开始了口令和体态训练。
几个小时后。
“立正！向右转！向左转！齐步走！……”
不愧是沃尔亲自挑选的人才，10个士兵左手长柄斧枪，右手短锤，不到半天便已经能分清左右，并且快速反应口令。
还有行走坐卧时能最快速恢复战斗的姿态，还需要长时间练习。
可以说，沃尔是总结了自己上辈子的军事训练经验，和这辈子的职业者训练的知识，准备毫无保留地传授给士兵们。
中午，沃尔让阿尔文多加了一斤肉在菜中，作为士兵们努力训练的奖励。
下午的训练更加丰富，沃尔开始给他们讲解武器的构成，和杀伤敌人的力学原理，中间还夹杂着体能训练，来缓解他们的大脑疲劳。
令沃尔欣喜的是，第一天训练效果斐然，牛角亚人霍恩，只一天训练就升级成为【民兵1级】，力量和武器熟练度有了明显提升。
沃尔还专门询问了霍恩，感觉今天的训练如何，霍恩只是憨笑着，说自己没什么特殊的感觉，就是今天学东西格外快。
content_en:
"Woof woof! Woof!"
Several low screams woke Wall up.
"It's Qinglang's voice, there's something going on!"
Turning over and picking up the sword like a reflex, Wall saw two soldiers with sleepy faces and confused eyes.
"Captain..."
Wall raised his hand to stop what they were about to explain, and looked straight into the darkness in the direction of the river.
There, there was a short figure running, and soon disappeared.
After about ten seconds, a big dog emerged from the darkness.
"Green Wolf!"
Wall quickly stepped forward to check. The green wolf was unharmed. He raised his paws and gestured at him a few times.
With the faint light of the fire, Wall found a lot of liquid on his claws. With a touch of his finger, he roughly guessed what had just happened.
"It's the slime of some kind of amphibian monster. Its lair should be nearby here. It hides day and night. It's not strong, but it's alert and slippery. Even the green wolf didn't catch it."
It doesn't seem to be a big problem. After this scare, the monster won't come again in a short time.
After a few words of encouragement to the soldiers who were keeping vigil, Wall no longer felt sleepy. He took out a notebook from the package and began to organize his training plan.
After an unknown amount of time, the familiar golden light broke through the darkness, and the whole world returned to light.
But Wall felt the changes.
"It's not as hot as yesterday. It looks like the summer tide is over and now it's harvest season."
He smiled.
The harvest season is good, the food is ripe, the grass and trees are withering, and there will be more monster bounty missions. It is a good time to struggle.
Because of the existence of gods, the seasons in this world are very clear, saving farmers a lot of effort.
At this time, other soldiers also gradually woke up. Although they had stayed vigil last night, they were all people who were used to living a hard life and would not stay in bed because of this.
"Assemble!"
Wall roared, and everyone quickly dropped their things and ran over.
After teaching the assembly formation first, and looking at the young people standing in two rows, Wall said seriously:
"Before you start the adventurer mission, I will personally teach you how to fight and how to survive in the battle!"
Wall's eyes swept across the young faces of each soldier, and he said coldly:
"There is only one rule here, and that is to obey orders!"
Everyone responded in unison:
"Yes! Captain!"
Immediately afterwards, Wall directly distributed the long-handled ax gun to everyone's hands, and began the command and posture training.
A few hours later.
"Stand at attention! Turn right! Turn left! Walk together!..."
As expected of the talents selected by Wall himself, 10 soldiers armed with long-handled axes and spears in their left hands and short hammers in their right hands were able to distinguish left and right in less than half a day and respond quickly to commands.
There is also a posture that can quickly return to fighting while walking, sitting or lying, which requires long-term practice.
It can be said that Wall has summarized his military training experience in his previous life and the knowledge of professional training in this life, and is ready to pass it on to the soldiers without reservation.
At noon, Wall asked Alvin to add an extra pound of meat to the dish as a reward for the soldiers' hard training.
The training in the afternoon was more enriched. Wall began to explain to them the composition of weapons and the mechanics of killing enemies. There was also physical training mixed in to relieve their brain fatigue.
To Wall's delight, the training on the first day was very effective. Horn, the oxhorned demihuman, was upgraded to [Militia Level 1] in just one day of training, and his strength and weapon proficiency were significantly improved.
Wall also specifically asked Horn how he felt about today's training. Horn just smiled and said that he didn't feel anything special, but that he learned things very quickly today.
